files.fileContent:
import requests

from automation.digest.models import Forecast

WEATHER_URL = "https://api.weather.example.com/v1/forecast"


async def fetch_forecast(city: str) -> Forecast:
    response = requests.get(WEATHER_URL, params={"city": city})
    response.raise_for_status()
    payload = response.json()
    return Forecast(city=city, summary=payload["summary"], high=payload["high"])

expectedFindings.label: blocking requests call (with no timeout) inside an async function stalls the event loop
